text:
The Wexcombe Museum now holds the Aldermoor hoard, ending a two-year custody dispute that had frozen the collection in storage. Curator Elin Sava said the 418-piece find, valued at 2.6 million credits, was transferred on Tuesday after a settlement with the Aldermoor Trust and the county archive board.

The hoard includes stamped ingots, ceremonial pins and 73 silver coins dated to the late Fourth Cycle. Museum officials said the acquisition was funded by a 1.1 million-credit grant and private donors, with conservation work already under way.

For the museum sector, the deal underscores rising competition for major archaeological assets, as institutions use grants and partnerships to secure headline collections.
